targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-778h (diagnostic, run_id v3_exq_sd068_rem_unpaired_null_anchorfix_diagnostic_20260718T183746Z_v3) is a same-question anchor-fix re-run of V3-EXQ-778d and PROMOTES AND DEMOTES NOTHING. Its content: the 1e-3 positivity-clamp artifact is CONFIRMED real (readiness anchor reproduced 778c's railed signature on 8/8 seeds -- 5 saturation, 3 positivity-floor collapse -- and the unpaired-target null de-railed on 7/8), but removing the artifact did NOT reveal content-contingency: the unclamped null_slope_ratio median is ~0.88 against a 0.25 ceiling, with 6 of the 7 de-railed seeds above the ceiling. The REM calibration_error readout responds to corruption MAGNITUDE irrespective of content, so it cannot adjudicate whether REM consolidation preserves content. This constrains the INSTRUMENT, not the mechanism -- no mechanism-level pressure on SD-068 / MECH-168 / MECH-169 / INV-047 either way. The manifest's own ceiling_inside_ci95: true OVERSTATES the uncertainty: that CI95 is computed over all 8 seeds including seed 7777, which failed the C1 de-rail predicate (clamp_frac 0.6 > 0.2, 2 unclamped sigmas < 3) and supplies the entire 85.18 outlier; on the C1-passing subgroup the conclusion is tighter, not weaker.

learning_extracted: Removing a measurement artifact can reveal that the underlying readout was already blind. The clamp was real and worth fixing, but it was MASKING a content-free readout rather than causing one -- confirming an artifact is not the same as validating the instrument behind it.

A subgroup statistic must honour the predicate that defines the subgroup. C2's CI95 included a seed that failed C1's de-rail gate, inflating the interval enough to make the manifest report ceiling_inside_ci95: true and read as underpowered.

Same-question alphabetic-suffix re-runs need an explicit non-double-counting rule: they should carry provenance, not a second unit of evidential weight. The supersession bookkeeping and the direction choice must be decided together, with the illusory-conflict check run against the pair.

The SD-068 REM leg now needs a content-sensitive readout, not another null-design iteration -- 778d/e/f plus this anchor-fix re-run have all bottomed out on the same readout channel. The next move is a different measurement axis, not another letter.
